title: Protein Language Model Based Structure-guided Antibody Screening for Disordered Protein Targets
authors: Akshay Chenna; Prasoon Priyadarshi; Keshav Kolluru; Saurabh Singal; Gaurav Goel
one_liner_zh: 该文用蛋白语言模型与深度学习，针对无序α-Synuclein C端肽段与LAG3的PPI进行抗体亲和力筛选，虽聚焦无序蛋白靶标且含AI方法，但互作机制建模深度有限，故评7分。
abstract: A crucial step in the pathogenesis of Parkinson’s disease involves cell-to-cell transmission of α -Synuclein proto-fibrils via endocytosis, driven primarily by the interaction of its disordered C-terminal peptide with domain 1 of Lymphocyte Activation Gene 3 (LAG3) neuronal receptors. High-affinity antibodies have been proposed as therapeutic modalities to delay this progression and subsequent amyloid formation. In our work, we develop an end-to-end computational pipeline to enable rapid screening of antibody sequences that have a high-affinity for the disordered C-terminal peptide of α -Synuclein using no information of known binders. This de novo screening was enabled by a structural bioinformatics based in silico data generation pipeline combined with a deep learning framework. Our simple feed forward network model built upon sequence embeddings from a protein language model ranked the binding affinities (ΔG) of antibodies to α -Synuclein with a high accuracy (Spearman ρ = 0.86) when the training and the evaluation datasets contained sequences having some overlap in the complementarity determining regions (CDRs). However, for vastly different CDR sequences, a transformer encoder model trained using the antibody sequence embeddings showed a low Spearman rank correlation of ρ = 0.18. The models have a mean Precision@100 of 38 and 12 respectively, significantly outperforming a random process. Overall, our work demonstrates a computational protocol for generating a high quality dataset of antibody-antigen complexes spanning a very large diversity in antibody sequences followed by training of a deep learning model for prediction of high-affinity antibody sequences for a specific protein target with no known binders.
abstract_zh: 帕金森病发病机制中的一个关键步骤涉及α-突触核蛋白原纤维通过内吞作用在细胞间传递，这一过程主要由其无序C末端肽与淋巴细胞活化基因3（LAG3）神经元受体结构域1的相互作用驱动。高亲和力抗体已被提议作为延缓该进展及后续淀粉样蛋白形成的治疗手段。在我们的工作中，我们开发了一个端到端的计算流程，以在不利用已知结合物信息的情况下，快速筛选对α-突触核蛋白无序C末端肽具有高亲和力的抗体序列。这种从头筛选通过基于结构生物学的计算机模拟数据生成流程结合深度学习框架得以实现。我们基于蛋白质语言模型序列嵌入构建的简单前馈网络模型，在训练和评估数据集包含互补决定区（CDRs）有一定重叠的序列时，对抗体与α-突触核蛋白的结合亲和力（ΔG）进行了高精度排序（Spearman ρ = 0.86）。然而，对于差异极大的CDR序列，使用抗体序列嵌入训练的Transformer编码器模型显示出较低的Spearman秩相关系数ρ = 0.18。模型的平均Precision@100分别为38和12，显著优于随机过程。总体而言，我们的工作展示了一种计算协议，用于生成覆盖抗体序列极大多样性的高质量抗体-抗原复合物数据集，随后训练深度学习模型，以预测针对特定蛋白靶点且无已知结合物的高亲和力抗体序列。
